entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Isn't it so tempting when it says[n]something's exclusive to that vending[n]machine?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Totally. What about the ones where you[n]can win a free drink?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's so annoying to lose, you end up[n]dumpin' in cash till you get one!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um... Sorry, I think that's just you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It was a sweltering summer day...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Er... All right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: As usual, to save money, I had exited the[n]train two stations early and walked the[n]rest of the way. The thirst was immense.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So, I approached a vending machine and[n]selected a bottle of water. However,[n]what it returned... was red bean soup...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I still shudder at the memory of that day.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Sounds like Yusuke-senpai had a pretty[n]traumatic experience...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah... You could say that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Aren't vending machines nice? I love[n]when they have things you can't find[n]anywhere else.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I do see unusual drinks at times, but[n]always end up getting the same old[n]thing I'm used to.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Maybe I'll try something different next[n]time.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yeah! That sounds like a great idea. I[n]recently saw something unusual myself.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think it was... canned grasshoppers,[n]or something?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: G-Grasshoppers!? That might be a little[n]too much for me...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: They've been getting a little too crazy[n]with the weird promotional drinks lately.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Does anyone actually buy those things?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Oh... Yeah, I always end up buying stuff[n]like that. Not just from vending machines,[n]but from anywhere.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Is that so? Why, just curious?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: No... It's more like...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Whenever I see stuff that nobody's[n]paying attention to... I can kinda[n]relate, so...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Are you all right, Mishima-kun?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey Sojiro, did you know? Vending[n]machines in Akiba are legendary![n]They're a match made in heaven!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Vending machines...? Really, now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If you ever wanted your snacks to be[n]chaotic neutral, they've gotcha covered![n]Try my personal fave, the Mystery Stew!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Yeah, that sounds like a mistake in a[n]can. You've had this before?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Nope!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Of course...
